audit.why: 42.65% over 136 games at 8/10 difficulty matches the shape: Lunge (400 range, 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s) plus Duelist's Dance Vitals beat a level 1-5 Sejuani who has one 650 charge and no sustain. The lane is conceded, the map is taken.
audit.corrected: Difficulty kept at 8/10; the reasons behind it were made mechanical instead of adjectival.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike is written as if Glacial Prison solves Riposte, and the first-item spike is built on a mechanic that does not exist ('your Permafrost passive window').
audit.why: Glacial Prison stuns — an immobilising effect — and Riposte 'stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability'. Parried, the bola does not just fail, it stuns you. And the armour the page keeps calling a Permafrost passive is Frost Armor from Fury of the North, an out-of-combat buff granting armour, MR and slow immunity; Permafrost is a 1.5s stun with no defensive component.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike is real but gated on Riposte's 24/22/20/18/16s cooldown; the first-item spike is Ravenous Hydra shredding Frost Armor, with Lunge's on-hit meaning armour alone misreads the trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is stated for Arctic Assault but never generalised, and the page suggests she might 'burn Riposte on the projectile' as if that were good for you.
audit.why: Riot on Riposte: 'Fiora parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect.' Every hard-CC piece Sejuani owns is immobilising — Arctic Assault's knock-up, Permafrost's stun, Glacial Prison's stun. All three convert Riposte from a parry into a stun on you. That single rule governs the entire matchup and was only half-written.
audit.corrected: Stated as one rule across early, mid, whys[4], wants.you[1] and the cooldown block: nothing with CC on it goes forward while Riposte is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Riposte as matchup-defining but gives no number, and calls Arctic Assault 'Q dash' with no cooldown.
audit.why: Riposte 24/22/20/18/16s against Arctic Assault 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s — her parry is longer than your only gap-close at every rank, so the window exists and is countable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' — vague, and wrong pronoun.
audit.why: Fiora heals from two sources in Riot's own text: Duelist's Dance ('If she hits the Vital, she restores Health') and Grand Challenge (heals Fiora and allies over time). Thornmail already carries Grievous Wounds on a tank build, so the anti-heal is free if the item order is stated.
audit.corrected: Thornmail named as the Grievous Wounds source, tied to the two heals it answers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Fiora as 'he'/'his' throughout (tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, feeding).
audit.why: Fiora is female; the rest of the site uses correct pronouns. This reads as a template that was never localised to the matchup.
audit.corrected: Corrected in the strings this proposal touches. Remaining 'his' instances in untouched paths are listed in notes.

edits.after: Levels 1 through 3 are a controlled concession — Lunge is free poke because she stabs a Vital and is gone before Winter's Wrath lands a second Frost stack. Lunge only reaches 400, so stand behind the wave and make her walk into Winter's Wrath's 600 range to take it. At level 3 you have the Q-W-E chain, but Riposte parries all incoming damage and disables for its duration, and because Arctic Assault's knock-up is an immobilise a parried charge stuns you and hands her a full Vital rotation on a stunned tank. Fake the approach to bait Riposte — 24 seconds at rank 1 — then chain Winter's Wrath into Permafrost inside that window.
edits.before: Levels 1 through 3 are a controlled concession — Fiora's Q poke is free because she dashes onto a vital and is gone before your W can apply a second Frost stack. Stand just behind the wave so her Q reach forces her to overextend, last-hit with W shard range, and do not step forward to trade without a full Frost stack already on her. At level 3 you have the Q-W-E chain, but she has Riposte: if she is sitting on the button, opening with Arctic Assault hands her a stun and she gets a full vital rotation on a stunned tank, which is a losing trade. Instead, fake the Q approach to bait the Riposte animation, then immediately chain W into Permafrost while she is locked out of it.

edits.after: Levels 4 through 5 are a true skill window — her Vital procs have built a health lead but she cannot kill you through Frost Armor, and you cannot burst her without landing CC through the Riposte threat. Sit at even HP, clear the wave, and look for jungler attention: your Permafrost stun into a gank converts because the second CC arrives from a third champion after her parry is gone. At level 6 Glacial Prison does not solve Riposte — the bola stuns, and Riposte stuns back anything that blocks an immobilising effect. Throw it only while her W is on cooldown, and note that Riposte falls from 24 seconds at rank 1 to 16 at rank 5, so the window narrows all game. Track that timer like a life bar.
edits.before: Levels 4 through 5 are a true skill window — her early vital procs have set a HP lead but she cannot outright kill you through Permafrost passive, and you cannot burst her without landing CC through the Riposte threat. Sit at even HP, clear the wave, and look for jungler attention: your Permafrost stun into a gank converts to a guaranteed kill Fiora cannot Riposte her way out of because the second CC is coming from a third champion. At level 6 Glacial Prison changes the math — throw the comet from a distance she doesn't expect, and if she Ripostes the projectile she burns it on the initiation rather than the follow-up stun chain. Track that Riposte cooldown (24 seconds) like a life timer.

notes: Two systemic problems, both likely to appear on other Sejuani pages. (1) 'Permafrost passive' / 'passive Permafrost armor' fuses two unrelated mechanics: Permafrost (E) is a 1.5s stun at max Frost stacks, while the armour, MR and slow immunity come from Fury of the North's Frost Armor, which is granted for being out of combat. Worth grepping champ-data/content/sejuani.js for 'Permafrost passive'. (2) The full layer for this matchup refers to Fiora as 'he' — remaining untouched instances are in breakdown.early ('his oversteps'), breakdown.wave ('toward him while Riposte is up'), breakdown.feeding, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d/[1].d, phases[2].why ('his counter-pattern') and report[3]/[9]/[11]. They were left alone rather than padded to fit the length band. Also: Glacial Prison is a bola in Riot's text, not a 'comet' — 'comet' appears across several Sejuani pages in the packet snippets and is a fabricated flavour name.
